a PROVISIONAL_FROM_SCHEMA fixture pins M2_UI_REPROBE, which execution-dag.json declares (passing the DAG-membership check) and whose milestones/executions.json record exits zero while attributing its capture to the fixture's own boundary_identifier react_client_runtime (passing the attribution check) -- discharging the fixture and letting the run pass. Removing M2_UI_REPROBE from execution-dag.json alone, with attribution unchanged, flips this same fixture to PINNED_REPROBE_MILESTONE_UNDECLARED: the DAG check runs first and is independent of attribution, so the two obligations do not substitute for each other.

the same PROVISIONAL_FROM_SCHEMA fixture pins M2_UI_REPROBE, which execution-dag.json declares (passing the DAG-membership check), and a same-named record exits zero -- but that record's boundary_identifier is POST /v1/search, not the fixture's own react_client_runtime, so the fixture stays outstanding rather than being discharged by a zero exit that observed a different boundary
